chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah from someone else from Aban ibn Uthman from Ismail ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the charity which is prohibited upon the Banu Hashim, what is it? He said: It is the Zakat. I said: So is the charity of some of them permissible upon others? He said: Yes.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Zakat and Sadaqah for Banu Hashim?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the prohibition for Banu Hashim applies specifically to Zakat, distinguishing it from Sadaqah (general charity), which remains permissible among them. This distinction is rooted in the principle that the Prophet’s family is exempt from Zakat as a mark of honor, yet they are not barred from receiving other forms of charity or giving it to each other, as confirmed by the phrase 'some of them upon some of them.'
